claims.statement: The ministry dates this period to approximately 30 BCE–395 CE.
Egypt became a Roman province; agriculture and production served the imperial economy.

evidence.note: Approximate period boundaries follow the Egyptian ministry. Other entries use museum chronologies, so boundaries can overlap or leave small gaps; these are dating differences, not evidence that nothing happened. The full source period extends beyond the initial 200 CE study window.
